title: fix(ui): restore inline per-subagent activity
body:
Related: #159179

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the loss of inline per-subagent activity after the Tasks/TaskFlow removal: a parent chat showed only an aggregate waiting count.

## User Impact

Each unfinished subagent is visible again with its name and current activity while the parent works or waits. Rows remain in launch order, distinguish queued and delegated work, and open the correct subagent details. On narrow screens, activity appears below the name.

## Why This Change Was Made

Restore the useful presentation without restoring TaskFlow. The view reuses the current child roster and safe observer headlines, with no child-transcript polling or additional execution state. Live headlines are fenced to the current run, session incarnation, agent, and connection. Completed children leave the inline list; existing failure/attention notices and the Subagents panel remain available.

The mocked Gateway now mirrors the existing broad observer-headline delivery contract, while keeping raw messages and tool arguments individually scoped.

## Evidence

- Red/green regression: the initial per-agent projection case failed on base `4ac1a8028b31` before the repair (activity was `undefined` instead of three rows; the other 19 cases passed). The same restored-status coverage passes with the fix. The Before capture also reproduces the missing rows through the actual chat UI.
- Focused unit/lifecycle/mock-Gateway coverage: 35 tests passed (3.16s test-run wall time; 4.81s wrapper).
- Browser coverage: 3 tests passed (45.58s including a production UI build), covering live updates, handoff/resume, subagent navigation, split panes, and stream isolation.
- Deterministic actual-UI captures inspected in dark/light at 1280px and dark at 390px. All names/headlines visible with no overflow; live observer updates cause zero child history reads.
- Independent P2 autoreview is clean after fixing and testing a queued-update/disconnect listener leak. Final changed-file gates passed: selected type graphs, UI types, lint/styles, formatting, i18n, dead-export checks, and source ratchets.
- [CI passed on the reviewed head](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38017166226). Measured CI wall time: UI unit shards 252–346 seconds; browser shard 1/9 took 439 seconds (whole-job time including setup, not per-file cost). Local changed unit files ran with --maxWorkers=1; added cases take milliseconds and reuse existing browser flows.
